1. ADP Essenza (Cologne)

Unisex:
4. ADP Oud (EDP)

author: @RokSlana
text:
Colonia Mirra is the scent that sent me into the world of fragrances somehow. Out of curiosity I've ordered a dozen sampels of different fragrances online (the 2ml ones), whatever I could find, all over the place, all different brands (I didn't have a clue what I was getting myself into). As I smelled them when I got to AdP Colonia Mirra my first thought was 'Who would  want to wear this? This almost smells like sweat, for Gods sake' and I put it aside as something I wasn't coming back to. A few days later out of curiosity I smelled it again - and this time something clicked in my brain. Suddenly I discovered something unusually pleasing in the strange scent and the more I smelled it the more I was in awe. It was like discovering a hidden world, It's hard to articulate the strangeness of going from sort of disgust to inspired by a scent  in a  matter of a few days. 

Keep up the content, cheers from Europe.

author: @RokSlana
text:
Colonia Mirra is the scent that sent me into the world of fragrances somehow. Out of curiosity I've ordered a dozen sampels of different fragrances online (the 2ml ones), whatever I could find, all over the place, all different brands (I didn't have a clue what I was getting myself into). As I smelled them when I got to AdP Colonia Mirra my first thought was 'Who would  want to wear this? This almost smells like sweat, for Gods sake' and I put it aside as something I wasn't coming back to. A few days later out of curiosity I smelled it again - and this time something clicked in my brain. Suddenly I discovered something unusually pleasing in the strange scent and the more I smelled it the more I was in awe. It was like discovering a hidden world, It's hard to articulate the strangeness of going from sort of disgust to inspired by a scent  in a  matter of a few days. 

Keep up the content, cheers from Europe.
